claim_ceiling: This stable package starts from the migration-selected Artifact Type contract, applies any recorded owner-review refinement, and binds its semantic dependencies to admitted Definitions. It does not admit the Artifact Type, admit any instance, authenticate fixture claims, integrate a consumer, or activate behavior.
distinct_validation_purpose: Defines one pre-run empirical test with explicit Project and Goal linkage, optional Research Inquiry and Product evaluation context, hypothesis, protocol, variables, measures, prerequisites, stop rules, timestamps, ownership, and challenge route.

four_facets.classification: Candidate Experiment Design with explicit source bindings.
four_facets.human_continuation: Generated RECORD.md and the complete-model review explain the revised contract, realistic example, dependencies, and claim limits.
four_facets.machine_checkable: Schema, typed reference closure and target-specific graph consistency checks.

name: Experiment Design

orthogonality_rules.statement: A design describes a bounded test and cannot represent execution, observations, measurements, or findings.

Project, Goals, explicit Research and Product evaluation links when present, protocol, variables, measures, stop rules, timestamps, owner, challenge route, limitations, and claim ceiling remain explicit.
Testing a Product Thesis outcome, Product Capability, or realization produces bounded evidence and cannot establish Product value, adoption, realization, conformance, or effectiveness by itself.

typed_residue.consequence: The package remains candidate-only and is absent from admitted Artifact Type authority.
typed_residue.missing: Artifact Type owner admission for this exact materialized package.

typed_residue.consequence: No operational or domain claim may be inferred from the candidate fixture.
typed_residue.missing: A real instance, bounded consumer integration, and an activation decision.
